question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is '**created**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate word for the **second** blank is 'created'.
 
• The given passage is about the creation of superheroes in Indian comics. It mentions various characters and publishers who have contributed to the Indian comic book industry.
 
• The sentence mentions Bantul, the great, which is a character that was created in 1965 during the Indo-Pak war. The word "**created**" refers specifically to the act of bringing a fictional character into existence. It is the most fitting option to describe the process of developing a character in a comic book.
 
• The other options do not fit as well with the context of the sentence. "**Generated**" is a more general term that can refer to any kind of output, while "**inspired**" and "**promoted**" are more related to the marketing or publicity of a character, rather than their creation.
 
• Therefore, "**created**" is the best option to fill in the second blank to accurately describe the origin of Bantul, the great.

 

Correct *Passage*:__ *Comics have (1) __produced__ many superheroes. Bantul, the great was **(2) __created__** in the year 1965 in the backdrop of the Indo-Pak war. Indrajal comics was set up in 1964 and (3) __________ Aabid Surti, who gave birth to a character called Bhadur in 1976 wearing kurta and jeans. Raj comics too (4) ________ into this sphere with their (5) ________ toons Nagraj, Tiranga and Shakti together called Brahman Rakshak (protectors of the universe).*
